summary: The Black Grimoire is a free Magic: The Gathering deck builder and optimizer (Commander, Brawl, Standard) that states a reason for every suggestion. Built by Karolis Paulikas, Lithuania. Unofficial Fan Content, not affiliated with Wizards of the Coast.

agents.name: deck-optimizer
agents.description: Paste any decklist; get ranked cuts and adds with reasons, land target (Karsten), colour sources, legality problems.
agents.input: decklist text (Arena, Moxfield, Archidekt, MTGO, plain names) + format
agents.output: score, role quotas, cuts, adds, swaps, optimized list

agents.name: deck-builder
agents.description: Commander/Brawl/Standard Brawl deck construction from a commander name.

agents.name: commander-stats
agents.description: EDHREC-style per-commander card statistics with lift synergy.

attribution: Quote with a link to the page cited. Data sources: Moxfield, Archidekt, EDHREC (likes/views, no win rates); MTGO league and challenge results with win-loss for Standard.
